searchQuery.description:
The query being compared to the {@link Genai.SourcePassage} indexed content
in the vector store

k.description: The number of similar passages to be returned by the similarity search

includeFileMetadata.description: Whether to include the {@link Genai.SourceFile.Metadata} in the results of the similarity search

doNotNormalizeScore.description: If true, {@link Genai.Retriever.SimilaritySearchResult#score} will be the raw non-normalized score.

mmrSpec.description:
Spec for MMR (Maximal Marginal Relevance) post-processing of the similarity search results
to support summarization.

metadataFilter.description:
Filter to apply to the {@link Genai.SourcePassage} metadata.
If set and `numMetadataPassages` > 0, a metadata-filtered similarity search will be performed
and its results will be appended to the overall results.

numMetadataPassages.description:
The number of passages to be returned by the similarity search
that match the metadata filter

keywordFilter.description:
Filter to apply to the {@link Genai.SourcePassage} keyword.
If set and `numKeywordPassages` > 0, a keyword-filtered similarity search will be performed
and its results will be appended to the overall results.

numKeywordPassages.description:
The number of passages to be returned by the similarity search
that match the keyword filter

parallelRun.description:
parallelRun is default by false
to run fetches parallely

title:
Specifies the arguments with which to call {@link Genai.Retriever#similaritySearch}.

The similarity search is composed of up to three separate retrievals:
1. A standard vector search using `searchQuery`.
2. A metadata-filtered search if `metadataFilter` is set and `numMetadataPassages > 0`.
3. A keyword-filtered search if `keywordFilter` is set and `numKeywordPassages > 0`.

The results of all applicable searches are appended together in the final result.
name: Genai.Retriever.SearchSpec
